Start with a clean workspace

```{r}
rm(list=ls())
```

The following defines a convenience function for loading libraries, installing if necessary.

```{r}
loadLibrary = function(packageName, suppressMessages = FALSE, githubRepo = NULL)
 {
  if (! require(packageName, character.only = TRUE)) {
    if (! is.null(githubRepo)) {
      loadLibrary("devtools")
      devtools::install_github(githubRepo)    
    }
    else 
      install.packages(packageName)
  
    if (suppressMessages)
      suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(packageName, character.only = TRUE))
    else 
      library(packageName, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}  
```

Duration for the experiment

```{r}
trialDuration <- mean(fd$trials$duration/1000,  trim = .25)

feedback <- fd$trials %>% filter(condition != 'CTRL')
```

Same function to calculate mean rating, mean true rating, mean false rating, difference between true and false ratings

```{r}
#uid - id for each participant, colName - share/prior column, factCol - groundTruthCol

ratingCalc <- function(data,colName,blockName,fun,test) {
  # get the data columns relevant to the calculation
  data <- data %>% select(!! sym(colName), uid, groundTruth)
  
  #get the data columns needed to calculate the mean prior without ground cond.
  all_data <- data %>% select(!! sym(colName), uid)
  
  #calculate mean prior rating without ground Truth.
  all_data <- data %>% select(!! sym(colName), uid) %>% group_by(uid) %>% summarise(all_=fun(!! sym(colName)))
  
  #calculate mean priors by uid and groud truth.
  temp <- data %>% group_by(uid,groundTruth) %>% summarise(Param = fun(!! sym(colName)))
  
  #convert the table form long to wide from and join it with all means 
  temp<- spread(temp, groundTruth, Param)
  d <- all_data %>% inner_join(temp, by=c('uid'))
  
  #calculate truth discernment and add a new column
  d$Diff = d$`TRUE` - d$`FALSE`
  
  d <- d %>% rename(True = `TRUE`, False = `FALSE` )
  
  colnames(d)[2:5] <- paste0(colnames(d[,c(2:5)]), blockName)
  colnames(d)[2:5] <- paste0(test, colnames(d[,c(2:5)]))

  return(d)
}
```

Filter out data from the from participants who did not believe there are other participants

```{r}
trialData <- fd$trials %>% filter(!feedback_q2 == '0-p')
```

Get data for A and C blocks for each participant

```{r}
#temp <- fd$trials %>% filter(!feedback_q2 == '0-p')

#A_block <- temp %>% filter(trialIndex %in% (0:9))
#C_block <- temp %>% filter(trialIndex %in% (40:49))

A_block <- trialData %>% filter(trialIndex %in% (0:9))
C_block <- trialData %>% filter(trialIndex %in% (40:49))
B_block <- trialData %>% filter(trialIndex %in% (10:39))

priorA <- ratingCalc(A_block,'prior' ,'belief_A',mean,'mean_')
priorC <- ratingCalc(C_block,'prior' ,'belief_C',mean,'mean_')

shareA <- ratingCalc(A_block,'share' ,'share_A',mean,'mean_')
shareC <- ratingCalc(C_block,'share' ,'share_C',mean,'mean_')

retwtA <- ratingCalc(A_block,'retValue' ,'retwt_A',sum,'sum_')
retwtC <- ratingCalc(C_block,'retValue' ,'retwt_C',sum,'sum_')
retwtB <- ratingCalc(B_block,'retValue' ,'retwt_B',sum,'sum_')

dim(priorA)
dim(priorC)
dim(shareA)
dim(shareC)
dim(retwtA)
dim(retwtC)
dim(retwtB)
```

```{r}
temp_demograhics <- demogData %>% select(uid, condition, crt_total)
```

# Analyzing credibility ratings

Hypothesis: People will get more accurate (improved truth discernment) in C block than A block after receiving feedback in B block compared to the control group.

```{r}
#Filter out the columns needed and create a dataframe.
priorData <- final %>% select(uid, condition, ConditionType, mean_all_belief_A, mean_Falsebelief_A,mean_Truebelief_A,mean_Diffbelief_A,mean_all_belief_C, mean_Falsebelief_C,mean_Truebelief_C,mean_Diffbelief_C, crt_total)

#calculate the differences between C block and A block prior ratings for each participant
priorData$mean_all_belief_Diff = priorData$mean_all_belief_C - priorData$mean_all_belief_A

priorData$mean_True_belief_Diff = priorData$mean_Truebelief_C - priorData$mean_Truebelief_A

priorData$mean_False_belief_Diff = priorData$mean_Falsebelief_C - priorData$mean_Falsebelief_A

priorData$truthDiscImprovement = priorData$mean_Diffbelief_C - priorData$mean_Diffbelief_A

```

## Means and SD of differences of prior ratings

```{r}
summPriorData <- priorData %>% select(condition,mean_all_belief_Diff,mean_True_belief_Diff, mean_False_belief_Diff, truthDiscImprovement) %>% group_by(condition) %>% summarise(allBeliefChange = mean(mean_all_belief_Diff),allBeliefChangeSD = sd(mean_all_belief_Diff), TrueBeliefChange = mean(mean_True_belief_Diff), TrueBeliefChangeSD = sd(mean_True_belief_Diff), FalseBeliefChange = mean(mean_False_belief_Diff), FalseBeliefChangeSD = sd(mean_False_belief_Diff), TruthDiscImprovement = mean(truthDiscImprovement), truthDiscImprovementSD = sd(truthDiscImprovement))

summPriorData
```

#### Truth Discernment Change Across Conditions

```{r}
plotmeans( formula = truthDiscImprovement ~ condition, data = priorData,  xlab = "Condition Group", ylab = "Truth Discernment Change", n.label = FALSE )
```

#### Overall Belief Change Across Conditions

```{r}
plotmeans( formula = mean_all_belief_Diff ~ condition, data = priorData,  xlab = "Condition Group", ylab = "Belief Change", n.label = FALSE )
```

Data transformations from priorData dataframe to graphData to get summary data required to draw bar-plot.

```{r}
graphData <- priorData %>% select(condition, mean_True_belief_Diff, mean_False_belief_Diff) %>% gather(GroundTruth, BeliefChange, mean_True_belief_Diff:mean_False_belief_Diff, factor_key = TRUE)

levels(graphData$GroundTruth)[levels(graphData$GroundTruth)=="mean_True_belief_Diff"] <- "True"
levels(graphData$GroundTruth)[levels(graphData$GroundTruth)=="mean_False_belief_Diff"] <- "False"

summarizedGraphData <-graphData %>% group_by(condition, GroundTruth) %>% summarise(n = n(),
                         mean = mean(BeliefChange),
                         sd = sd(BeliefChange),
                         se = sd/sqrt(n),
                         ci = se * qt((1-0.05)/2 + .5, n-1))

summarizedGraphData
```

#### Mean belief change by condition group by ground truth

```{r}
ggplot(summarizedGraphData, aes(x=condition, y=mean, fill=GroundTruth)) + 
    geom_bar(position=position_dodge(), stat="identity") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=mean-ci, ymax=mean+ci),
                  width=.2,                    # Width of the error bars
                  position=position_dodge(.9)) + ylab("Mean Belief Change") + xlab("Condition Group")
```

```{r}
tempData <- priorData %>% select(condition,mean_Falsebelief_A,mean_Truebelief_A,mean_Falsebelief_C, mean_Truebelief_C) %>% gather(v, val, mean_Falsebelief_A:mean_Truebelief_C)%>% separate(v, c("type", "GroundTruth","Block")) %>% select(-type)

tempData$GroundTruth <- as.factor(tempData$GroundTruth)

levels(tempData$GroundTruth)[levels(tempData$GroundTruth)=="Truebelief"] <- "True"
levels(tempData$GroundTruth)[levels(tempData$GroundTruth)=="Falsebelief"] <- "False"

#summarizedGraphData <- tempData %>% group_by(condition, GroundTruth, Block) %>% summarise(n = n(),mean = mean(val),sd = sd(val),se = sd/sqrt(n),ci = se * qt((1-0.05)/2 + .5, n-1))

#summarizedGraphData

ggplot(tempData, aes(x=Block, y=val, fill=GroundTruth)) + 
    geom_boxplot() + facet_wrap(~condition)
```

### Initial Observations:

-   Overall belief has gone down in feedback groups compared to control group.

-   Belief in true items has reduced in feedback groups compared to control group. This effect seems to be strongest in the negative feedback group.

-   Belief in false items has reduced in feedback groups compared to control group.

-   Truth discernment seems to have reduced in both feedback groups compared to control group. This effects seems to be bigger for the negative feedback group.

#### ANOVA Test to Compare Truth Discernment Improvement Between Conditions

```{r}
tDisc.anova <- aov( truthDiscImprovement ~ condition, priorData )
print(tDisc.anova)
summary(tDisc.anova)
```

*The ANOVA test result suggests that there is no difference in the changes in truth discernment between the groups*

#### ANOVA Test to Compare Overall Belief Change Between Conditions

```{r}
oBC.anova <- aov( mean_all_belief_Diff ~ condition, priorData )
print(oBC.anova)
summary(oBC.anova)
```

*The ANOVA test results suggest that there is a significant change in overall belief between groups.*

#### Pairwise T test with Holm Correction to compare overall belief change between groups

```{r}
posthocPairwiseT(oBC.anova)
```

*The results suggest that overall belief has gone down in both feedback groups compared to control. However, the type of feedback does not have an effect on overall belief.*

#### ANOVA Test to Compare Belief Change in True Items Between Conditions

```{r}
tBC.anova <- aov( mean_True_belief_Diff ~ condition, priorData )
print(tBC.anova)
summary(tBC.anova)
```

```{r}
posthocPairwiseT(tBC.anova)
```

#### ANOVA Test to Compare Belief Change in False Items Between Conditions

```{r}
fBC.anova <- aov( mean_False_belief_Diff ~ condition, priorData )
print(fBC.anova)
summary(fBC.anova)
```

*Therefore, we can conclude that truth discernment has not improved after receiving feedback compared to control group. However overall belief has gone down - primarily through the reduction of belief in true items. They type of feedback does not seem to have an effect.*

```{r}
tempData <- priorData %>% filter(condition == 'GRPN')
ggplot(tempData, aes(x=crt_total, y=mean_True_belief_Diff)) + geom_point()
cor.test(tempData$mean_True_belief_Diff, tempData$crt_total)
```

# Analyzing changes in sharing behaviour

Hypothesis 1: Sharing likelihood of false items will reduce in C block compared to A block after receiving constructive feedback (GRPP) in B block compared to control group

Hypothesis 2: Sharing likelihood of both true and false items will reduce in C block compared to A block after receiving critical feedback (GRPN) in B block compared to control group

```{r}
#Filter out the columns needed and create a dataframe.
shareData <- final %>% select(uid, condition, ConditionType,mean_all_share_A, mean_Falseshare_A,mean_Trueshare_A,mean_Diffshare_A,mean_all_share_C,mean_Falseshare_C,mean_Trueshare_C,mean_Diffshare_C)

#calculate the differences between C block and A block share ratings and retweet counts for each participant

shareData$mean_all_share_Diff = shareData$mean_all_share_C - shareData$mean_all_share_A

shareData$mean_Falseshare_Diff = shareData$mean_Falseshare_C - shareData$mean_Falseshare_A

shareData$mean_Trueshare_Diff = shareData$mean_Trueshare_C - shareData$mean_Trueshare_A

shareData$mean_shareDiscern_Diff = shareData$mean_Diffshare_C - shareData$mean_Diffshare_A

```

### Mean and SD of differences in share ratings and re-tweet counts

```{r}
shareData %>% select(condition, mean_all_share_Diff,mean_Falseshare_Diff,mean_Trueshare_Diff,mean_shareDiscern_Diff) %>% group_by(condition) %>% summarise(
  allShareChange = mean(mean_all_share_Diff),
  allShareChangeSD = sd(mean_all_share_Diff),
  TrueShareChange = mean(mean_Trueshare_Diff),
  TrueShareChangeSD = sd(mean_Trueshare_Diff),
  FalseShareChange = mean(mean_Falseshare_Diff),
  FalseShareChangeSD = sd(mean_Falseshare_Diff),
  shareDiscern = mean(mean_shareDiscern_Diff),
  shareDiscernSD = sd(mean_shareDiscern_Diff)
)
```

#### Plotting means of overall sharing likelihood change

```{r}
plotmeans( formula = mean_all_share_Diff ~ condition, data = shareData,  xlab = "Condition Group", ylab = "Overall Sharing Likelihood Change", n.label = FALSE )
```

#### ANOVA test to compare the sharing likelihood change between the groups.

```{r}
oSL.anova <- aov( mean_all_share_Diff ~ condition, shareData )
print(oSL.anova)
summary(oSL.anova)
```

*The results indicate that overall sharing in the three condition groups has not changed.*

### Comparing changes in sharing likelihood in true and false items between conditions

Data transformation of sharing data for plotting.

```{r}
graphData <- shareData %>% select(condition, mean_Trueshare_Diff, mean_Falseshare_Diff) %>% gather(GroundTruth, ShareLikelihdChange, mean_Trueshare_Diff:mean_Falseshare_Diff, factor_key = TRUE)

levels(graphData$GroundTruth)[levels(graphData$GroundTruth)=="mean_Trueshare_Diff"] <- "True"
levels(graphData$GroundTruth)[levels(graphData$GroundTruth)=="mean_Falseshare_Diff"] <- "False"

summarizedGraphData <-graphData %>% group_by(condition, GroundTruth) %>% summarise(n = n(),
                         mean = mean(ShareLikelihdChange),
                         sd = sd(ShareLikelihdChange),
                         se = sd/sqrt(n),
                         ci = se * qt((1-0.05)/2 + .5, n-1))

summarizedGraphData
```

#### Mean sharing likelihood change by condition by ground truth.

```{r}
ggplot(summarizedGraphData, aes(x=condition, y=mean, fill=GroundTruth)) + 
    geom_bar(position=position_dodge(), stat="identity") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=mean-ci, ymax=mean+ci),
                  width=.2,                    # Width of the error bars
                  position=position_dodge(.9)) + ylab("Mean Sharing Likelihood Change") + xlab("Condition Group")
```

#### ANOVA test to compare sharing likelihood change of true items between conditions

```{r}
tSLC.anova <- aov( mean_Trueshare_Diff ~ condition, shareData )
print(tSLC.anova)
summary(tSLC.anova)
```

#### ANOVA test to compare sharing likelihood change of false items between conditions

```{r}
fSLC.anova <- aov( mean_Falseshare_Diff ~ condition, shareData )
print(fSLC.anova)
summary(fSLC.anova)
```

*Similar to overall sharing likelihood, the tests indicate that the change in sharing likelihood of true and false items are not significant.*

### Analyzing change in sharing with other participants

```{r}
#Filter out the columns needed and create a dataframe.
retwtData <- final %>% select(uid, condition, ConditionType,sum_all_retwt_A, sum_Falseretwt_A,sum_Trueretwt_A, sum_Diffretwt_A,sum_all_retwt_B,sum_Falseretwt_B,sum_Trueretwt_B,sum_Diffretwt_B,sum_all_retwt_C,sum_Falseretwt_C,sum_Trueretwt_C,sum_Diffretwt_C)


#calculate the differences between C block and A block share ratings and retweet counts for each participant

retwtData$sum_all_retwt_Diff = retwtData$sum_all_retwt_C - retwtData$sum_all_retwt_A

retwtData$sum_Falseretwt_Diff = retwtData$sum_Falseretwt_C - retwtData$sum_Falseretwt_A

retwtData$sum_Trueretwt_Diff = retwtData$sum_Trueretwt_C - retwtData$sum_Trueretwt_A

retwtData$sum_retwtDiscern_Diff = retwtData$sum_Diffretwt_C - retwtData$sum_Diffretwt_A
```

```{r}
retwtData %>% select(condition,sum_all_retwt_Diff,sum_Falseretwt_Diff,sum_Trueretwt_Diff,sum_retwtDiscern_Diff) %>% group_by(condition) %>% summarise(
  allRtwtChange = mean(sum_all_retwt_Diff),

  TrueRtwtChangeSD = sd(sum_Trueretwt_Diff),
  FalseRtwtChange = mean(sum_Falseretwt_Diff),
  FalseRtwtChangeSD = sd(sum_Falseretwt_Diff),
  RtwtDiscern = mean(sum_retwtDiscern_Diff),

)
```

#### Plotting means of overall sharing likelihood change
